rationale: Both Alon and Ben are building in the robotics space—Alon is focused on dexterous manipulation technology for humanoid robots using learning-based approaches at Aora, while Ben is exploring robotics and AI through SF Agents & Robots. Given the complementary nature of their domains, there's potential value in exchanging perspectives on how AI and robotic systems intersect, particularly around the technical challenges of building intelligent robotic systems.
intro_message: Alon Ko, meet Ben Holfeld — you're both founding companies at the intersection of robotics and AI, and could benefit from comparing approaches to building intelligent robotic systems.
